questions.stem: A population of rabbits reaches a stable level. Which factor is most likely responsible?

options.text: The rabbits have stopped reproducing entirely
There are no predators in the area
Resources such as food and space have become limiting factors

questions.explanation: When a population stabilises, it has typically reached the carrying capacity of the environment. At this point, limiting factors such as food availability, space, and water prevent further population growth, as the birth rate equals the death rate.
